data.text: Except as provided in Sentence (2), required exit stairs and public stairs serving buildings of residential occupancy shall have a width of not less than 900 mm.
Risers in private stairs shall have a maximum height of 200 mm and a minimum height of 125 mm.
Treads in rectangular stairs shall have a minimum run of 255 mm and a maximum run of 355 mm.
Stairs shall have a handrail on at least one side where the stair is less than 1100 mm in width.
Stairs 1100 mm or more in width shall have handrails on both sides.
The height of handrails on stairs and ramps shall be not less than 865 mm and not more than 1070 mm.
Except as provided in Sentences (2) to (4), every surface to which access is provided for other than maintenance purposes shall be protected by a guard where the elevation difference exceeds 600 mm.

data.text: Guards for residential exterior balconies shall have a height of not less than 1070 mm where the walking surface is more than 1800 mm above adjacent ground.
Openings through any guard shall be of a size that prevents the passage of a spherical object having a diameter of 100 mm.
The slope of ramps in pedestrian egress pathways shall not exceed 1 in 10 for interior ramps and 1 in 8 for exterior ramps.
Every public corridor shall have a clear width of not less than 1100 mm.
Exit doors serving an occupant load of more than 60 persons shall open in the direction of exit travel.

data.text: Every doorway serving as a required exit shall provide a clear opening width of not less than 800 mm.
The travel distance from any point in a floor area to an exterior exit shall not exceed 45 m in unsprinklered buildings.
The vertical clear headroom over stairs measured vertically from the line connecting the leading edge of treads shall be not less than 2050 mm.
The means of egress shall have a ceiling height of not less than 2 meters.
The minimum width of each door opening shall provide a clear width of not less than 810 mm.
The maximum width of a swinging door leaf shall be 1.2 meters nominal.
Thresholds at doorways shall not exceed 19 mm in height for sliding doors or 12.7 mm for other doors.
The width of stairways shall be determined as specified in Section 8.5.1, but such width shall not be less than 1.1 meters.

data.text: Stair riser heights shall be 178 mm maximum and 102 mm minimum.
The minimum tread depth shall be 280 mm measured horizontally between vertical planes of adjoining risers.

data.text: Stairways shall have handrails on each side in accordance with this section.
Handrail height, measured above stair tread nosings, shall exist uniformly between 864 mm and 965 mm.
Ramps used as part of a means of egress shall have a running slope not steeper than one unit vertical in 12 units horizontal (8 percent slope).

data.text: Guards shall form a protective barrier not less than 1067 mm high, measured vertically above the adjacent walking surface.
In buildings without an automatic sprinkler system, exit access travel distance shall not exceed 61 meters.
The minimum corridor width shall be not less than 1118 mm where serving an occupant load of 50 or more.

data.text: Landings at doors shall have a length measured in the direction of travel of not less than 1.1 meters.
Stairways shall have a minimum headroom clearance of not less than 2032 mm measured vertically from the sloped plane connecting tread nosings.
